from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    overall_bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != overall_bg]
    col_separators = [c for c in range(width) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != overall_bg]
    if row_separators:
        sep = row_separators[0]
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    else:
        sep = col_separators[0]
        a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    colors_a = Counter(v for row in a for v in row)
    colors_b = Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg_a = colors_a.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = colors_b.most_common(1)[0][0]
    if bg_a in colors_b and bg_b not in colors_a:

    elif bg_b in colors_a and bg_a not in colors_b:

    return [[3 if a[r][c] == common and b[r][c] == common else common
